sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pusp Raj Singh,Mohd. Samiuzzaman Khan Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mohd. Samiuzzaman Khan, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 618 of 2018 under Sections 498A, 304B IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Bidhnoo, District Kanpur Nagar, with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

The applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place five months prior to the incident and that the allegations of dowry demand and harassment made against the applicant, are false.

In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has Ravi Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20706810/
1 been shown on the body of deceased and hyoid bone has been shown intact and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment have been made against all the accused persons including the applicant.

It was further submitted that in fact deceased was having some affair with some person since before her marriage and that she has remained only for some days at her matrimonial home and she has committed suicide due to that reason.

At the time of incident,
the applicant was not present at spot and he was at his shop.

4. It is further submitted that first bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 7.3.2022 and the trial court was directed to expedite the trial and to decide the same preferably within a period of six months from the date of filing of certified copy of the order.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that only one witness has been examined so far by the trial court,
whereas the applicant is in jail since 5.11.2018.

It was pointed out that after examination of P.W.1,
the prosecution has moved application under Section 319 Cr.P.C., which has been allowed by the trial court and that order has been challenged before this Court, hence in view of these facts, trial would take sufficient long time.
The applicant has already undergone the detention of more than five years.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and the first bail application has already been rejected on merits.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, the period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ravi Singh, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Kumar Manish.
